description: Z tag-and-probe of the lepton efficiencies (AN-16-442; binning and fit conventions after efficiency_tnp_an): single-lepton-triggered tags, the AN loose lepton as the probe (dR > 0.2 from the tag, one probe per tag and step, the one closest to m_Z), the selection chain id | loose, sip | id, iso | id and sip (AN FSR-subtracted isolation, AN tight muon), the full step measured directly; pass and fail fitted simultaneously with the efficiency as a parameter; every fit inspected on the galleries, manual fixes as overrides.  v5 (user decision 2026-09-24): signal = the DY-MC template of prompt-prompt pairs per bin and category convolved with a Gaussian, CMSShape background, alternatives DSCB signal and Bernstein-3 background; efficiency errors from MINOS; electrons mvaFall17V2noIso WPL.  v6 (fits_i1 inspection of v5): adaptive template smoothing, |eta|-column template fallback, EGM CMSShape ranges, narrower low-mass Gaussian ranges of the DSCB alternative; histograms with the calibration v4 payload.  v7 (fits_i1 inspection of v6; user decision 2026-09-25): the fail signal template mixed with a free pass-like fraction (the bin's pass template), a nearest-neighbour floor of the template kernel, merges of the |eta| column within a factor 2 then 4 in pT, effective-weight errors for weighted MC, the DSCB alternative with a low-mass Gaussian in the pass as well, and alternatives with inflated errors kept out of the fit-model systematic.

extract.comment: Loose preselection of the compact tag-and-probe pairs: a pair is kept if at least one leg is a tag candidate on its raw quantities (the event fired a tag path of the leg's flavour, the leg is matched to an HLT object carrying a tag filter bit with trigger pT above trig_pt_min, and its raw pT is above pt_min, below the final tag thresholds to allow for the calibration); raw mass window

tag.comment: Final tag on the calibrated momenta, path-consistent: muons: HLT_IsoMu24 fired and matched with the Iso bit (2), or HLT_IsoTkMu24 fired and matched with the IsoTkMu bit (8), trigger-object pT >= 24, offline pT > 26 (plateau), |eta| < 2.4, POG tightId, pfRelIso04 < 0.15; electrons: HLT_Ele27_WPTight_Gsf fired with trigger-object pT >= 27, or HLT_Ele25_eta2p1_WPTight_Gsf with trigger-object pT >= 25 and |eta_SC| < 2.1, matched with the 1e WPTight bit (2), offline pT > 30, |eta_SC| < 2.1 outside 1.4442-1.566, cut-based tight (AN tag).

probe.comment: The AN loose lepton on the calibrated momenta (the skim floors carry |dxy| < 0.5 and |dz| < 1 cm): muons pT > 5 GeV, |eta| < 2.4, global or tracker with a matched station; electrons pT > 7 GeV, |eta| < 2.5.  A probe lies at dR > 0.2 from its tag; per tag and step only the probe closest to m_Z is kept (efficiency_tnp_an).

steps.comment: The selection chain, each step on the probes passing the previous ones: id (AN tight muon: PF, or tracker high-pT above 200 GeV; electrons mvaFall17V2noIso WPL, the stage-4b starting point), sip (SIP3D < 4), iso (AN FSR-subtracted relative isolation < 0.35, h4l::fsr_in_isolation); full = id, sip, iso on the loose probes (direct cross-check of the product).

bins.comment: The fine binning of efficiency_tnp_an (for millions of distinct probes): probe pT (calibrated) and |eta| (muons |eta|, electrons |eta_SC|) lower edges, the last pT bin unbounded; the value at (45 GeV, 1.2), which lies on bin edges, is the bilinear interpolation between the neighbouring bin centres.

histogram.comment: 0.5 GeV storage bins of the calibrated pair mass in 60-120 GeV (the fits use the narrowest of 0.5, 1, ..., 3 GeV with at least 40 entries per bin); the signal templates (DY MC, prompt-prompt pairs) in 50-130 GeV at 0.25 GeV so that the Gaussian smearing of the fit has no edge effect

fit.comment: Binning and inspection after efficiency_tnp_an; model by the user decision of 2026-09-24: signal = template of the prompt-prompt DY-MC pairs of the bin and category (below min_effective_entries: the bin's |eta| column with the neighbouring pT rows added nearest first while their lower pT edges stay within merge_pt_factor of the bin's, then the pT row, then inclusive), smoothed with an adaptive Gaussian kernel (Abramson: pilot bandwidth pilot_scale min(sigma, IQR/1.34) n^-1/5 of the entries within peak_half_window of m_Z, local width scaled by (pilot density / geometric mean)^-alpha, clamped to [min_width, max_width] GeV), convolved with a Gaussian (shift, width per category; shared below shared_resolution_below entries); background CMSShape erfc((alpha - m) beta) exp(-gamma (m - m_Z)) with the EGM tag-and-probe ranges of cmsshape; a category below small_category_below entries keeps the inclusive background shape; alternatives: analytic stand-alone DSCB signal (width model starting values, bounds x3 with relaxation; the fail DSCB mixed with a Gaussian low-mass component within alt_signal_hump) and Bernstein-3 background; two starting points; EDM convergence; efficiency error from MINOS (sandwich-scaled for weighted MC), floored at the binomial error; rejection of narrow background maxima near m_Z; categories below min_category_entries are counting only; overrides = the manual fixes from the gallery inspection; exclude_alternatives = alternatives that the inspection found not to describe a bin (kept out of its fit-model systematic, with a note).  v6 changes after the v5 fits_i1 inspection: the fixed 0.5 GeV template smoothing broadened the peaks of high-statistics templates (coherent pulls at the peak of every pass fit above ~70k entries) while leaving wiggles in sparse fail templates; the pT-row fallback was wider than the central-|eta| fail peaks; the CMSShape ranges 30-85 / 0.005-0.2 / 0-1 let the fail background form humps under the Z; the low-mass Gaussian of the DSCB alternative (60-88 GeV, 1.5-10 GeV) fitted narrow fluctuations and the falling background.  v7 changes after the v6 fits_i1 inspection (eight inspectors, every page): data fail peaks narrower than the MC fail template and a smaller FSR-hump fraction in data (|eta| 1.4-1.6) -> the pass-like admixture phi of the fail template (MC fits give phi ~ 0 with their own templates); template statistical wiggles of sparse fail templates -> the nearest-neighbour kernel floor (min_kernel_entries) and min_effective_entries 1000 (a template-to-data statistics ratio was tried and rejected: it merged the dense pass templates and distorted them; a stronger Abramson alpha = 1 oversmoothed the pass tails); the sandwich covariance of weighted MC gave absurd errors (up to +-1.8) in weakly constrained fits -> effective-weight scaling; the DSCB alternative lacked a pass radiative component (its pass background absorbed the continuum) -> a pass low-mass Gaussian, the fail one down to 55 GeV.

fail_pass_like.comment: fail signal = (1 - phi) fail template + phi pass template of the same bin (each normalized in the window), phi free per fit: data fails contain relatively more well-measured, pass-shaped probes than the MC fail template (v6 inspection; user decision 2026-09-25)

cmsshape.comment: EGM tag-and-probe nominal ranges (acms 50-80, beta 0.01-0.06, gamma 0.005-1)

alternatives.comment: an alternative whose data or MC efficiency error exceeds this multiple of the nominal error (a degenerate fit) is kept out of the fit-model systematic
